title: The Silver Antlers
rumor: The Silver Antlers. Hunters describe a great white stag whose antlers glimmer with silver in the moonlight. It appears only to those traveling alone and always flees toward the same wooded ravine. Some believe it guards an ancient Thalenweald shrine; others insist that the creature is a spirit seeking someone worthy of following it.
first_lead: Sightings cluster near the wooded headwaters of a Redwash tributary.
